implementation_gate.name: stage2_grpo_two_dof_multiplicative_reverse_transition_noise
implementation_gate.scope: Replace only the three stochastic reverse DDIM transitions used by joint GRPO with per-trajectory longitudinal/lateral multiplicative noise while preserving standard full-coordinate additive initial noising at t=8, deterministic termination at t=0, trajectory-chain tensor shapes, rollout semantics, and the existing pseudo-Gaussian PPO data flow.

implementation.independence: batch, group, vehicle role, and mode are independent; all eight waypoints share one longitudinal and one lateral draw
implementation.heading: not sampled directly; reconstructed from XY

verification.focused_command: XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH=/home/kong/diffusion_codes/Diffusion-meta/Diffusion-metadrive-test-noise /home/kong/anaconda3/envs/meta_drive/bin/python -c <metadata-filter-and-pytest> -- tests/test_bev_joint_grpo_a.py tests/test_bev_joint_grpo_b.py tests/test_bev_joint_grpo_online.py tests/test_bev_reward_comparison.py tests/test_compare_grpo_stability.py
covered: exact DiffusionDriveV2-style multiplicative formula and the 0.04 sampling floor
two axis draws broadcast over eight waypoints with independent batch, group, role, and mode draws
fixed-seed repeatability and replay without RNG consumption
0.1 pseudo-likelihood floor, waypoint/XY reduction, deterministic t=0, and unchanged additive t=8 initial noising
behavior-policy replay ratio equals one before perturbation and finite ratio, clipping, KL, loss, and gradients after perturbation
v7 config/report/checkpoint persistence, best-checkpoint binding, exact resume acceptance, and legacy or drifted resume rejection
v3 A/B manifest/report persistence and rejection of cross-arm transition-noise drift
